title: Membership in a predicate-defined set
statement: For any type $\alpha$, element $x\in\alpha$, and predicate $p:\alpha\to\mathrm{Prop}$, membership of $x$ in the set $\{y\mid p(y)\}$ is equivalent to $p(x)$.
